title: create_transaction_with_valid_data
description: Test creating a transaction with valid data including type, amount greater than zero, wallet_id, category, and date. Verify response status 201 Created and that the returned transaction object contains correct fields.

title: create_transaction_with_zero_amount
description: Test creating a transaction with amount equal to zero. Verify response status 400 Bad Request with validation error message 'Nominal harus lebih dari 0'.

title: create_transaction_without_authorization
description: Test creating a transaction without providing Authorization header. Verify response status 401 Unauthorized.

title: create_wallet_with_valid_data
description: Test creating a wallet with valid data including name, type, balance, and currency. Verify response status 201 Created and that the returned wallet object includes id and balance.

title: create_wallet_missing_name_field
description: Test creating a wallet with missing required field 'name'. Verify response status 400 Bad Request with validation error 'name is required'.

title: list_wallets_without_authorization
description: Test listing wallets without Authorization header. Verify response status 401 Unauthorized.

title: ai_process_with_high_confidence_input
description: Test AI processing endpoint with natural language input that yields high confidence extraction of transaction fields. Verify response status 200 OK with extracted fields and confidence scores.

title: ai_process_with_low_confidence_input
description: Test AI processing endpoint with ambiguous natural language input resulting in low confidence extraction. Verify response status 200 OK with partial extracted fields and flags indicating review required.

title: ai_process_with_provider_error
description: Test AI processing endpoint when Anthropic API key is invalid or provider error occurs. Verify response status 502 Bad Gateway with sanitized provider error message.

title: import_mutasi_with_supported_file_and_preview
description: Test bank mutation import endpoint by uploading a supported CSV or XLSX file with preview=true parameter. Verify response status 200 OK with preview payload containing parsed rows and duplicate flags.
